name: notification-preferences
title: Notification preferences
description: Grid of events by channel (email, push, SMS, in-app) with a switch per cell and a switch per channel.
htmlExample: <bef-notification-preferences class="max-w-2xl" :value='{"leave":["email","push","app"],"payroll":["email"],"mention":["push","app"],"digest":["email"],"security":["email","sms","push","app"]}' :channels='[{"id":"email","label":"Email"},{"id":"push","label":"Push"},{"id":"sms","label":"SMS"},{"id":"app","label":"In-app"}]' :events='[{"id":"leave","label":"Leave requests","description":"Submitted, approved or rejected"},{"id":"payroll","label":"Payslips","description":"When a new payslip is ready"},{"id":"mention","label":"Mentions and comments"},{"id":"digest","label":"Weekly digest","description":"Monday summary of your team"},{"id":"security","label":"Security alerts","description":"New sign-ins and password changes"}]' emit="change"></bef-notification-preferences>
